### Helper models

Models this attack drives, configured under its `roles`. Each one is a [ModelConfig](../../cli/campaign-files/target.md#modelconfig).

| Role | Kind | Needed | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `attacker` | chat model | required | Writes the jailbreak prompts, guided by strategies from the library. |
| `embedder` | embedding model | required | Embedding model that indexes the library, so the strategies closest to the target's last reply can be looked up. |
| `summarizer` | chat model | required | Turns an exchange that worked into a short, reusable strategy and adds it to the library. |

### Parameters

Settings for the algorithm itself, written under the attack's `parameters`. Anything left out keeps its default.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `epochs` | integer (>= 1) | `100` | Attempts per goal in warm-up, and per pass in the lifelong phase. Each one costs an attacker, a target and a panel call. |
| `break_score` | number (>= 0.0, &lt;= 10.0) | `8.5` | Panel score (0-10) at which the search for a goal stops. Whether the goal counts as jailbroken is still the panel's verdict. |
| `warmup_iterations` | integer (>= 1) | `1` | Intended passes over the goals during warm-up. Not read yet: warm-up makes one pass. |
| `lifelong_iterations` | integer (>= 1) | `1` | Passes of `epochs` rounds over each goal in the lifelong, strategy-guided phase. |
| `skip_warmup` | boolean | `false` | Skip warm-up and start from an empty library, growing it as it goes. |

### In a campaign file

```yaml
attacks:
- name: autodan_turbo
  roles:
    attacker:
      name: llama3.2
      connection:
        provider: ollama
        type: OLLAMA
    embedder:
      name: nomic-embed-text
      connection:
        provider: ollama
        type: OLLAMA
    summarizer:
      name: llama3.2
      connection:
        provider: ollama
        type: OLLAMA
```

:::note[Needs a helper model]

This attack cannot run without `attacker`, `embedder`, `summarizer`. A campaign that leaves it out fails to resolve, before anything is attacked.

:::
